cues.en: So, we've got this nice code to evaluate recommender systems, and we intend to try out quite a few different ones throughout the rest of this course.
cues.zh: 我們已有不錯的程式碼能評估推薦系統，接下來的課程也打算嘗試許多不同系統。

cues.en: What we need now is a framework to let us easily experiment with new recommender system algorithms, evaluate them, and compare them against each other.
cues.zh: 現在需要一個框架，讓我們能輕鬆實驗新的推薦演算法、評估它們，並互相比較。

cues.en: SurpriseLib provides us with some of what we need, but we're going to build on top of it.
cues.zh: SurpriseLib 提供部分所需功能，但我們會在它之上擴充。

cues.en: Let me show you the various pieces we're going to use and how they fit together.
cues.zh: 來看看會使用哪些部分，以及如何組合。

cues.en: Surpriselib has a Python base class called AlgoBase.
cues.zh: SurpriseLib 有一個叫做 AlgoBase 的 Python 基底類別。

cues.en: If you don't know what a base class is, then you're probably new to object oriented design.
cues.zh: 如果不知道什麼是基底類別，可能是還不熟悉物件導向設計。

cues.en: It's an easy concept, though.
cues.zh: 不過，概念很簡單。

cues.en: Fundamentally, a class is just a collection of functions organized under some name.
cues.zh: 基本上，類別就是一組以某個名稱組織起來的函數。

cues.en: That class can also have variables associated it.
cues.zh: 類別也可以有相關聯的變數。

cues.en: And, you can instantiate an instance of a class object, which lets you keep around a copy of a classes functions and the data in its variables under a single name you can work with.
cues.zh: 你可以建立類別物件的實例，讓一份類別函數與變數資料，以一個可操作的名稱保留下來。

cues.en: It'll make more sense when we look at some code, trust me.
cues.zh: 相信我，看到程式碼時會更容易理解。

cues.en: Object oriented design allows us to have base classes, for example, AlgoBase, that contain functions and variables that can be shared by other classes that inherit from that base class.
cues.zh: 物件導向設計允許我們建立基底類別，例如 AlgoBase，包含能讓其他繼承它的類別共用的函數與變數。

cues.en: So for example, here we have an SVD class which inherits from the AlgoBase base class.
cues.zh: 例如，這裡有一個 SVD 類別，繼承 AlgoBase 基底類別。

cues.en: That means that our SVD class may have functions and data specific to the SVD recommender algorithm, but it also has access to the functions and data defined in the AlgoBase base class.
cues.zh: 這表示 SVD 類別除了具備 SVD 推薦演算法專用的函數與資料，也能存取 AlgoBase 定義的函數與資料。

cues.en: It's just a way to maintain consistent interfaces with all of our different recommender algorithms.
cues.zh: 這只是一種讓不同推薦演算法維持一致介面的方法。

cues.en: For example, the AlgoBase base class defines the function names, fit and test, which are used to train and to test each algorithm.
cues.zh: 例如 AlgoBase 基底類別定義 fit 與 test 這兩個函數名稱，分別用來訓練與測試每種演算法。

cues.en: So, no matter what the actual algorithm may be, we know that we can always call fit or test on it.
cues.zh: 因此，不管實際演算法是什麼，我們都知道一定能呼叫 fit 或 test。

cues.en: SVD, KNNBasic, SVDpp, and any custom algorithm we might develop that inherits from AlgoBase, can all be used in the same way.
cues.zh: SVD、KNNBasic、SVDpp，以及我們自行開發、繼承 AlgoBase 的任何演算法，都能以相同方式使用。

cues.en: This makes things a lot easier when you are trying to train and evaluate many different algorithms, since you can use the same code to do so.
cues.zh: 這讓訓練與評估許多不同演算法容易得多，因為可以使用相同程式碼。

cues.en: These are just a few of the recommender algorithms that are build into surpriselib.
cues.zh: 這些只是 SurpriseLib 內建推薦演算法的一小部分。

cues.en: Custom isn't one that they offer, but it's just my way of illustrating that you may write your own recommender algorithms and make them part of the surpriselib framework.
cues.zh: Custom 並不是它提供的演算法，只是用來說明你可以自己寫推薦演算法，並將它納入 SurpriseLib 框架。

cues.en: You're not limited to the ones they provide.
cues.zh: 你不受限於它提供的演算法。

cues.en: So, how do you write your own recommender algorithm that's compatible with surpriselib?
cues.zh: 那麼，如何撰寫與 SurpriseLib 相容的推薦演算法？

cues.en: It's surprisingly easy.
cues.zh: 出乎意料地簡單。

cues.en: See what I did there?
cues.zh: 有發現這個雙關嗎？

cues.en: Surprisingly easy, I kill me.
cues.zh: Surprise，出乎意料地簡單，連我都被自己逗笑了。

cues.en: All you have to do is create a new class that inherits from AlgoBase, and as far as surpriselib is concerned, your algorithm has one job, to predict ratings.
cues.zh: 只要建立一個繼承 AlgoBase 的新類別。對 SurpriseLib 而言，你的演算法只有一個工作：預測評分。

cues.en: As we mentioned, surpriselib is built around the architecture of predicting the ratings of every movie for every user, and giving back the top predictions as your recommendations.
cues.zh: 如前所述，SurpriseLib 的架構是預測每位使用者對每部電影的評分，再把預測最高的項目作為推薦傳回。

cues.en: It's not ideal, but its necessary for evaluating accuracy offline.
cues.zh: 這並不理想，但離線評估準確程度時，是必要的。

cues.en: So your class needs to implement an estimate function, that's it.
cues.zh: 因此，類別只需要實作 estimate 函數，就是這樣。

cues.en: Let's look at the entire code for a custom recommender algorithm that does this.
cues.zh: 看看實作這件事的自訂推薦演算法完整程式碼。

cues.en: Yeah, that's all there is to it.
cues.zh: 對，就只有這些。

cues.en: The estimate function takes in three arguments.
cues.zh: estimate 函數接受三個引數。

cues.en: The first, self, is the first argument in any class method in object oriented Python.
cues.zh: 第一個 self，是物件導向 Python 中每個類別方法的第一個引數。

cues.en: It's a reference to the instance of the object that is currently being worked with, so you can access variables associated with that instance.
cues.zh: 它參照目前操作的物件實例，讓你能存取該實例相關的變數。

cues.en: Next it takes in a user ID and an item ID.
cues.zh: 接著，接受使用者 ID 與項目 ID。

cues.en: So, when estimate is called by the surpriselib framework, it's asking you to predict a rating for the user and item passed in.
cues.zh: 因此，SurpriseLib 框架呼叫 estimate 時，是要求你預測傳入的使用者與項目所對應的評分。

cues.en: These user and item ID's are inner ID's by the way, ID's that are used internally, and must be mapped back to the raw user and item ID's in your source data.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這些使用者與項目 ID 是內部 ID，必須映射回來源資料中的原始使用者與項目 ID。

cues.en: In this simple example, our new recommender algorithm called MyOwnAlgorithm, just predicts a rating of three stars for absolutely everything and everybody.
cues.zh: 這個簡單例子中，新推薦演算法 MyOwnAlgorithm，對所有人、所有東西，一律預測三顆星。

cues.en: I doubt it would perform very well, but this as simple as it gets.
cues.zh: 我不覺得它表現會很好，但這已經是最簡單的例子。

cues.en: Note there is also some boilerplate code for initializing the MyOwnAlgorithm class object, which just calls the base classes init function, but if you had to do some setup in preparation
cues.zh: 注意，還有一些初始化 MyOwnAlgorithm 類別物件的固定程式碼，只呼叫基底類別的 __init__ 函數；如果要準備

cues.en: for doing something more complicated than just predicting three all the time, that might be a good place to do it.
cues.zh: 比永遠預測三顆星更複雜的事情，這裡可能很適合做初始化。

cues.en: Make sense?
cues.zh: 理解嗎？

cues.en: If not, stare at this code a bit until it does.
cues.zh: 如果不理解，就多看這段程式碼，直到理解為止。

cues.en: It's kind of important.
cues.zh: 這有點重要。

cues.en: Now, we want to do more than just predict ratings.
cues.zh: 現在，我們想做的不只是預測評分。

cues.en: We want to make it easy to apply all those different evaluation metrics we implemented earlier in our RecommenderMetrics class to the algorithms we work with.
cues.zh: 我們希望能輕鬆把之前在 RecommenderMetrics 類別中實作的不同評估指標，套用到使用的演算法。

cues.en: So to do that, we're going to create a new class called EvaluatedAlgorithm.
cues.zh: 為此，要建立一個叫做 EvaluatedAlgorithm 的新類別。

cues.en: It contains an algorithm from surpriselib, but introduces a new function called Evaluate that runs all of the metrics in RecommenderMetrics on that algorithm.
cues.zh: 它包含一個 SurpriseLib 演算法，並新增 Evaluate 函數，對該演算法執行 RecommenderMetrics 裡的所有指標。

cues.en: So, this class makes it easy to measure accuracy, coverage, diversity, and everything else on a given algorithm.
cues.zh: 因此，這個類別讓我們能輕鬆衡量某個演算法的準確程度、覆蓋率、多樣性，以及其他所有指標。

cues.en: It uses the functions in the RecommenderMetrics class we wrote already to do this, so we don't have to re-write all of that code.
cues.zh: 它使用之前寫好的 RecommenderMetrics 類別函數，因此不必重寫那些程式碼。

cues.en: Now, to evaluate a recommender system in several different ways, we'll want to slice up our training data into train and test splits in various different ways.
cues.zh: 要以多種方式評估推薦系統，得用不同方式，將訓練資料切分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: That's what our EvaluationData class is for.
cues.zh: 這就是 EvaluationData 類別的用途。

cues.en: It takes in a DataSet, which might come from our class that loads MovieLens data for example, and creates all the train/test splits needed by our EvaluatedAlgorithm class.
cues.zh: 它接受一個 DataSet，例如由載入 MovieLens 資料的類別產生，再建立 EvaluatedAlgorithm 所需的所有訓練／測試分割。

cues.en: So you can see how this all starts to fit together.
cues.zh: 你可以看到，這些部分開始組合起來了。

cues.en: We can start by creating an instance of EvaluationData for a given data set, which will slice and dice that data in all the ways need it to evaluate it, and then we can test many different algorithms
cues.zh: 先為特定資料集建立 EvaluationData 實例，它會用評估所需的各種方式切分資料，再用相同的評估資料，測試許多不同演算法，

cues.en: using that same evaluation data, by wrapping those algorithms with an EvaluatedAlgorithm instance.
cues.zh: 方法是把演算法包在 EvaluatedAlgorithm 實例中。

cues.en: Then call the Evaluate function on EvaluatedAlgorithm, passing in our EvaluationData, to measure the performance of that algorithm.
cues.zh: 接著，對 EvaluatedAlgorithm 呼叫 Evaluate，傳入 EvaluationData，衡量演算法表現。

cues.en: See how it all connects?
cues.zh: 看出這些部分如何連接了嗎？

cues.en: We create an EvaluationData instance with our data set, create an EvaluatedAlgorithm for each algorithm we want to evaluate, and call Evaluate on each algorithm using the same EvaluationData.
cues.zh: 以資料集建立 EvaluationData 實例，為每個待評估演算法建立 EvaluatedAlgorithm，再使用相同 EvaluationData，對每個演算法呼叫 Evaluate。

cues.en: Under the hood, EvaluatedAlgorithm will use all the functions we defined in RecommenderMetrics to measure accuracy, hit rate, diversity, novelty, and coverage.
cues.zh: 在內部，EvaluatedAlgorithm 會使用 RecommenderMetrics 中定義的所有函數，衡量準確程度、命中率、多樣性、新穎性與覆蓋率。

cues.en: Since what we generally want to do is compare different recommender algorithms against each other, we can make life even easier by writing a class that takes care of all that comparison for us.
cues.zh: 由於通常想做的是比較不同推薦演算法，因此還可以寫一個類別，替我們處理所有比較工作，讓事情更簡單。

cues.en: Ideally, we'd like to just submit algorithms we want to evaluate against each other into this class, and let it do everything from there.
cues.zh: 理想上，只要把想互相比較的演算法交給這個類別，其餘都由它處理。

cues.en: That's what our Evaluator class does.
cues.zh: 這就是 Evaluator 類別的工作。

cues.en: Our Evaluator class just takes in a raw dataset, say from MovieLens, and the first thing it does is create an EvaluatedDataset object from it that it uses internally.
cues.zh: Evaluator 類別只接受原始資料集，例如 MovieLens，第一件事就是從中建立內部使用的 EvaluatedDataset 物件。

cues.en: Then, you just call AddAlgorithm for each algorithm you want to compare.
cues.zh: 然後，對每個想比較的演算法，呼叫 AddAlgorithm。

cues.en: This creates an EvaluatedAlgorithm under the hood within the Evaluator, and adds it to a list internally called algorithms.
cues.zh: 它會在 Evaluator 內部建立 EvaluatedAlgorithm，並加入名為 algorithms 的內部串列。

cues.en: Finally, when you call Evaluate, it evaluates each EvaluatedAlgorithm, and prints out the results from each one in a nice tabular form.
cues.zh: 最後，呼叫 Evaluate，它就會評估每個 EvaluatedAlgorithm，並以整齊的表格印出每個結果。

cues.en: So, the beauty of this is that you don't even have to use the EvaluatedAlgorithm or EvaluatedData classes at all when you want to start playing around with new algorithms and testing them against each other.
cues.zh: 好處是，開始實驗新演算法、互相比較時，根本不必直接使用 EvaluatedAlgorithm 或 EvaluatedData 類別。

cues.en: All you need to do is use this Evaluator class, which has a really simple interface.
cues.zh: 只要使用這個介面非常簡單的 Evaluator 類別。

cues.en: The reason we're doing all of the trouble of developing this framework is so we can do this.
cues.zh: 我們費這麼多工夫開發框架，就是為了做到這件事。

cues.en: This is all the code it takes to compare the SVD algorithm against the Random algorithm, run every evaluation metric we have on both, and compare the two.
cues.zh: 這些就是比較 SVD 與 Random 演算法所需的全部程式碼，對兩者執行所有評估指標，並加以比較。

cues.en: All we do is load up our MovieLens data set, and pass that into our Evaluator.
cues.zh: 只要載入 MovieLens 資料集，傳給 Evaluator。

cues.en: Then we call AddAlgorithm for both our SVD and Random algorithms, call Evaluate, and that's it!
cues.zh: 再對 SVD 與 Random 演算法分別呼叫 AddAlgorithm，呼叫 Evaluate，就完成了。

cues.en: Let's dive into the code so we can see what it's doing in more detail, and run it, and see how it works!
cues.zh: 深入看看程式碼，進一步了解它做什麼，執行後看看如何運作。
